Choose your starter at Professor Oak’s lab. Collect Oak’s Parcel in Viridian City and bring it back. You then receive the Pokédex and Poké Balls. Get the Town Map from your rival’s sister.
Sprich den Angestellten des Pokémon-Mark: Speak to the Poké Mart employee for a Potion. You have no Poké Balls on your first trip; catch Pokémon on the way back after receiving the Pokédex.
Hole Eichs Paket im Markt. Nach der Rück: Collect Oak’s Parcel at the Mart. After you deliver it, the old man demonstrates how to catch Pokémon. The Gym opens after seven Badges. Return later for Surf-accessible items and the Macho Brace.
Der frühe Abstecher bietet zusätzliche A: This early detour offers extra species and an optional rival battle. The Pokémon League entrance remains blocked until you have the required Badges.
Reise durch den Vertania-Wald nach Marmo: Travel through Viridian Forest to Pewter City. Reach the eastern side later through Diglett’s Cave or with Cut. Oak’s aide gives you HM05 once you have caught ten species.
Suche Grasflächen und die Seitenwege nac: Search the grass and side paths for items. Hidden items are marked on the item map too. Pikachu is rare, so allow some time to find it.
Besiege Rocko für den Felsorden und TM39: Defeat Brock for the Boulder Badge and TM39. Receive the Running Shoes at the exit towards Route 3. Return with Cut for the Old Amber in the museum.
Besiege die Trainer und suche die Grasfl: Battle the Trainers and search the grass before Mt. Moon. You can buy Magikarp in the Pokémon Center by the entrance; you can also catch it later with the Old Rod.
Erkunde die Leitern und Nebenräume vor d: Explore the ladders and side rooms before leaving. After the Rocket battle, choose the Helix Fossil or Dome Fossil. You cannot normally obtain the other fossil in this save.
Sammle die Funde vor dem Sprung nach Azu: Collect the items before jumping down towards Cerulean City. The ledges are one-way for now. Fishing encounters and Surf-accessible items become available later.
Besiege Misty für den Quellorden. Hilf B: Defeat Misty for the Cascade Badge. Help Bill on Route 25 for the S.S. Ticket. On your return, head south through the burgled house. Exchange the Bike Voucher for a Bicycle later.
Besiege den Rivalen und die Trainer der: Defeat your rival and the Trainers on Nugget Bridge. Collect the Nugget and search the western grass patch.
Hilf Bill in seinem Küstenhaus; du erhäl: Help Bill in his seaside cottage to receive the S.S. Ticket. Explore the dead ends between Trainers. Some items require Cut or Surf later.
Nutze die Pension für ein einzelnes Poké: Use the Day Care for one Pokémon. This Day Care cannot produce Eggs. While the guards block Saffron City, take the Underground Path to Route 6.
Der Tunnel verbindet Route 5 und 6. Auf: The tunnel connects Routes 5 and 6. Hidden items lie on the floor; use the numbered markers.
Fange neue Arten auf dem Weg nach Orania: Catch new species on the way to Vermilion City. Surf and fishing encounters are listed below for later.
Hole die Angel beim Angler, den Kampffah: Get the Old Rod from the Fishing Guru, the Vs. Seeker in the Pokémon Center and the Bike Voucher in the Fan Club. Explore the S.S. Anne before it leaves. Use Cut to reach Lt. Surge’s Gym.
Durchsuche alle Kabinen und den Küchenbe: Search every cabin and the kitchen before leaving. After the rival battle, the captain gives you HM01 Cut. Once you leave the ship after receiving it, the ship departs permanently: any remaining items are missed.
Suche das Gras und das Wachhaus ab. Eich: Search the grass and gatehouse. Oak’s aide gives you the Itemfinder once you have caught 30 species. The Snorlax at the eastern exit requires the Poké Flute later.
Der Tunnel führt zur Ostseite von Route: The tunnel leads to the east side of Route 2. There you will find HM05, an in-game trade and items behind Cut trees.
Nutze Zerschneider östlich von Azuria un: Use Cut east of Cerulean City and follow the ledges towards Rock Tunnel. Check the branches before each jump.
Heile vor dem Felstunnel. Später führt S: Heal before entering Rock Tunnel. Later, Surf along the river to reach the Power Plant. Both tunnel exits belong to this route.
Blitz erleichtert die Orientierung, ist: Flash helps you navigate but is optional. Explore both floors and the side paths; Lavender Town lies beyond.
Im Pokémon-Turm kannst du zunächst noch: You cannot identify all the ghosts in Pokémon Tower yet. Travel along Route 8 and through the tunnel to Celadon City for the Silph Scope.
Gehe nach Westen. Solange Saffronia gesp: Head west. While Saffron City is blocked, the Underground Path leads to Route 7.
Dieser Tunnel verbindet Route 8 und 7. S: This tunnel connects Routes 8 and 7. Check the map for hidden floor items too.
Nimm die Grasfläche mit und gehe nach Pr: Search the grass and continue to Celadon City. Later, give Tea to a guard to enter Saffron City.
Hole den Tee im Wohnhaus, Evoli über den: Get Tea in the mansion, Eevee through its rear entrance and the Coin Case in the restaurant. The Department Store sells Evolution stones. Defeat Erika, then examine the poster in the Rocket Game Corner.
Löse die Pfeilboden-Passagen auf jeder E: Navigate the arrow tiles on every floor. Get the Lift Key, defeat Giovanni and collect the Silph Scope.
Mit dem Silph Scope kannst du Geister fa: The Silph Scope lets you catch ghosts. The Marowak ghost cannot be caught. Rescue Mr. Fuji for the Poké Flute. Later, use the Itemfinder on his former tile for the Soothe Bell.
Gib einer Stadtwache den Tee. Im Kampf-D: Give Tea to a city guard. In the Fighting Dojo, choose Hitmonlee or Hitmonchan. Free Silph Co. before challenging Sabrina.
Hole die Schlüsselkarte auf Ebene 5 und: Get the Card Key on 5F and explore the locked rooms. After the rival battle, receive Lapras on 7F. Defeat Giovanni and speak to the president for the Master Ball.
Wecke Relaxo mit der Pokéflöte und fange: Wake Snorlax with the Poké Flute and catch it before defeating it. Get HM02 Fly behind the Cut tree. Cycling Road requires a Bicycle. Leftovers lie on Snorlax’s former tile.
Fahre den Radweg hinunter und erkunde di: Ride down Cycling Road and explore the side strips. Several hidden items lie along the route.
Suche das Gras am Ende des Radwegs und d: Search the grass at the end of Cycling Road and the gatehouse. The in-game trade differs by version.
Hole die Superangel im Anglerhaus. Wecke: Get the Super Rod in the Fishing Guru’s house. Wake Snorlax with the Poké Flute; use the Itemfinder on its former tile for Leftovers. Fishing and Surf open up more encounters and items.
Suche die Grasfläche hinter Zerschneider: Search the grass behind the Cut tree and the winding paths. The route leads south towards Fuchsia City.
Prüfe Gras und Zaunwege. Neue Arten häng: Check the grass and fenced paths. Species differ by version; Pokémon you have recorded disappear from the route’s missing list.
Erkunde auch den oberen Weg hinter Zersc: Explore the upper path behind the Cut tree too. Oak’s aide in the gatehouse gives you the Exp. Share once you have caught 50 species.
Hole die Profiangel im Anglerhaus. Besie: Get the Good Rod in the Fishing Guru’s house. Defeat Koga to use Surf. Return the Gold Teeth from the Safari Zone to the Warden for HM04 Strength; move his boulder for another item.
Plane den Weg zum geheimen Haus für VM03: Plan your path to the Secret House for HM03 Surf, picking up the Gold Teeth just before it. Explore all four areas across several visits. Rare Safari Pokémon may flee.
Surfe auf Route 10 zum Eingang. Erkunde: Surf from Route 10 to the entrance. Explore every passage: some item balls are Voltorb or Electrode. Save before approaching Zapdos.
Surfe von Fuchsania nach Süden und halte: Surf south from Fuchsia City and check for new Surf and fishing encounters.
Erkunde beide Seiten der Seeschauminseln: Explore both sides of Seafoam Islands. Redirect the currents inside the caves with Strength boulders.
Schiebe die passenden Felsen durch die L: Push the correct boulders through the holes to the lower floors. Stop the currents to reach Articuno and the western exit.
Die Verbindung von Alabastia zur Zinnobe: The route between Pallet Town and Cinnabar Island has grass on an island, as well as Surf and fishing encounters.
Lass Fossilien im Labor wiederbeleben. H: Revive fossils in the lab. Get the Secret Key in the Pokémon Mansion and defeat Blaine. Bill then offers a trip to One Island.
Nutze die Schalter an den Statuen und de: Use the statue switches and the correct drop from 3F. Get the Secret Key in the basement for Blaine’s Gym, and search every room for items.
Sprich mit Celio im Pokémon-Center. Erfü: Speak to Celio in the Pokémon Center. Complete Bill’s errand on Two Island and Three Island. Return after the League and National Pokédex for the Ruby quest and Rainbow Pass.
Surfe südlich von Eiland Eins zum Strand: Surf south of One Island to the beach. Hidden beach items may return after you walk enough steps; the app records your first pickup.
Erkunde den Weg zum Glutberg. Zertrümmer: Explore the path to Mt. Ember. Smashable rocks hold extra encounters; get Rock Smash in Ember Spa.
Sprich den alten Mann im Inneren für VM0: Speak to the old man inside for HM06 Rock Smash. The hot spring heals your party.
Mit Stärke erreichst du den Gipfel und L: Use Strength to reach the summit and Moltres. The northeastern side path to the Ruby opens after the National Pokédex and Celio’s request.
Speak to the father in the Game Corner. Find his daughter on Three Island and bring her back before finishing Bill’s errand.
Erkunde den Pfad und das Wasser. Die Att: Explore the path and water. With enough friendship, the Move Tutor can teach your fully evolved Kanto starter its special move.
Besiege die Biker vor der Stadt. Reise ü: Defeat the Bikers outside town. Cross the bridge to Berry Forest and rescue the missing girl.
Der Hafen verbindet die Stadt mit dem Tr: The port links the town to the Tri-Pass ferry. Return to the expanded Three Isle Path after receiving the National Pokédex.
Folge der Brücke zum Beerenforst. Erkund: Follow the bridge to Berry Forest. Use Surf to explore the water and southern sandy area.
Rette das Mädchen vor Hypno. Suche die W: Rescue the girl from Hypno. Search the paths for hidden Berries; these can grow back.
Kehre mit sieben Orden nach Vertania Cit: Return to Viridian City with seven Badges. Defeat Giovanni for the Earth Badge and TM26. Then use the Itemfinder exactly on his former tile for the Macho Brace. Continue along Route 22 and through the Badge checkpoints on Route 23 towards the League.
Die Wachen kontrollieren deine acht Orde: The guards check your eight Badges. Bring Surf and Strength for the journey to the League. Check the water and hidden items along the path.
Besiege Giovanni in Vertania für den ach: Defeat Giovanni in Viridian City for the eighth Badge. Pass the Badge checkpoints on Route 23. Solve Victory Road’s Strength switches and search all three floors.
Bereite Heilitems und ein vielseitiges T: Bring healing items and a varied team. Defeat the Elite Four and Champion. With at least 60 caught Kanto species and the Sevii errand completed, Professor Oak can give you the National Pokédex.
Nach der Liga: Erhalte bei Professor Eic: After the League, get the National Pokédex from Professor Oak with at least 60 caught Kanto species and the Sevii errand completed. Speak to Celio on One Island and visit the northeastern entrance on Mt. Ember. Defeat the Rockets, collect the Ruby down the side path and bring it to Celio. Receive the Rainbow Pass for Four Island through Seven Island.
Mit dem Bunt-Pass erreichst du Eiland Vi: The Rainbow Pass lets you reach Four Island. Its Day Care can produce Eggs with two parents. Find Lorelei in Icefall Cave.
Hole VM07 Kaskade und setze sie am Wasse: Get HM07 Waterfall and use it at the waterfall. Help Lorelei against Team Rocket; this opens the way to the Sapphire.
Erkunde die Insel und ihre Seitengebiete: Explore the island and its side areas. The Rocket Warehouse needs two passwords: one from Mt. Ember and one from the Sapphire theft.
Prüfe die Grasflächen und Funde um das R: Check the grass and items around the Rocket Warehouse. Both passwords unlock its door.
Surfe zum älteren Mann. Bei hoher Freund: Surf to the elderly man. With a friendly lead Pokémon and a free party slot, he gives you a Togepi Egg.
Erkunde die kleinen Inseln mit Surfer. N: Explore the small islands with Surf. After rescuing Selphy in Lost Cave, she offers repeatable Pokémon requests.
Die Steinzahlen zeigen Uhrzeitrichtungen: Read the rock counts as clock directions: 3 right, 6 down, 9 left, 12 up. To Selphy: right, up, down, down, right, left, down, right, up. Side routes lead to item rooms.
Surf south from the meadow to Memorial Pillar. Leave Lemonade at the grave, then speak to the Trainer for TM42.
Von hier erreichst du nördlich die Wasse: From here, explore the water routes to the north and Ruin Valley with Dotted Hole to the south.
Suche Land- und Wasserwege ab. Im Haus k: Search the land and water paths. In the house, compare a large Pokémon’s size for a record; the requested species differs by version.
Folge den Wasserwegen zum Musterbuschwal: Follow the water routes to Pattern Bush and towards Outcast Island. Explore the small beaches too.
Suche die Grasflächen nach den hier vork: Search the grass for the Bug Pokémon found here. The unusual ground pattern does not change the encounter table.
Surfe in den Norden zu Fern-Eiland und d: Surf north to Outcast Island and Altering Cave. Search the small land patches and water.
Im unveränderten Spiel erscheint hier nu: Only Zubat appears here in an unmodified game. The planned replacement encounters were never normally distributed, so they are not listed as regular catches.
Hilf zuerst Lorelei in der Eiskaskadenhö: Help Lorelei in Icefall Cave first. Use Cut to open the entrance to Dotted Hole.
Nach dem ersten Loch lautet die Reihenfo: After the first hole, go up, left, right, down. A scientist steals the Sapphire; note the second Rocket Warehouse password.
Öffne die Tür mit beiden Passwörtern. Lö: Open the door with both passwords. Navigate the arrow tiles, defeat the Rockets and recover the Sapphire from the scientist. Bring it to Celio on One Island.
Im Norden wartet der Trainerturm, im Süd: Trainer Tower lies to the north; the Tanoby Ruins lie to the south. Check the houses and town items too.
Wähle einen der vier Kampfmodi. Für die: Choose one of four battle modes. Each mode has a different reward for beating its record. These are mode rewards, not normal floor pickups.
Reise nach Süden zum Sevault-Canyon. Nut: Travel south to Sevault Canyon. Search the grass for new species.
Erkunde die Seitenwege und die Tanoby-Sc: Explore the side paths and Tanoby Key chamber. The Strength puzzle activates Unown encounters in the ruins.
Schiebe alle sieben Felsen auf die Verti: Push all seven boulders into the holes. Unown then appear in the Tanoby Chambers.
Surfe zwischen den sieben Kammern. Die v: Surf between the seven chambers. Unown’s forms count as one Pokédex species; activate Tanoby Key first.
Die Höhle öffnet erst nach Liga, Nationa: The cave opens after the League, the National Pokédex and repairs to Celio’s Network Machine. Search every floor with Surf and Strength. Mewtwo waits in the basement.
Historisches Event: Für Ho-Oh und Lugia: Historical event: Ho-Oh and Lugia required a MysticTicket. Without a legitimately obtained ticket, this area cannot normally be reached.
Historisches Event: Deoxys braucht das A: Historical event: Deoxys requires an AuroraTicket. Solve the triangle puzzle to battle it. Without an existing event ticket, the island cannot normally be reached.

Eines von drei Starter-Pokémon bei Profe: Choose one of three starters at Professor Oak’s lab. The other two initially require trading; breeding is possible later if you have a suitable parent.
Vom Verkäufer im Pokémon-Center für 500: Buy it from the seller in the Pokémon Center for ₽500.
Durch den Hintereingang der Prismania-Vi: Enter the Celadon Mansion from the back, go to the rooftop room and take the Poké Ball. One-time gift.
Nach dem Rivalenkampf mit dem Mitarbeite: After the rival battle, speak to the employee on 7F. One-time gift.
Nach dem Sieg über den Karate-Meister ei: After defeating the Karate Master, choose one Poké Ball: Hitmonlee OR Hitmonchan per save. Later, breeding Tyrogue can give you access to the other evolution.
Helixfossil im Fossilienlabor abgeben, R: Give the Helix Fossil to the fossil lab, leave the room and return. The Helix and Dome Fossils are a one-time choice in Mt. Moon. Use Cut to obtain Old Amber in Pewter Museum.
Domfossil im Fossilienlabor abgeben, Rau: Give the Dome Fossil to the fossil lab, leave the room and return. The Helix and Dome Fossils are a one-time choice in Mt. Moon. Use Cut to obtain Old Amber in Pewter Museum.
Altbernstein im Fossilienlabor abgeben,: Give the Old Amber to the fossil lab, leave the room and return. The Helix and Dome Fossils are a one-time choice in Mt. Moon. Use Cut to obtain Old Amber in Pewter Museum.
Mit einem Pokémon mit maximaler Freundsc: Speak to the Gentleman in Water Labyrinth with a Pokémon at maximum friendship leading your party. Leave a free party slot, then hatch the Egg.
Mit der Pokéflöte wecken. Einmalige Bege: Wake it with the Poké Flute. One-time encounter; another Snorlax is on Route 16.
Wake it with the Poké Flute. One-time encounter; another Snorlax is on Route 12.
Zwei vermeintliche Itembälle sind feste: Two apparent item balls are fixed level 34 Electrode encounters.
Am Ende des Kraftwerks. Vor dem Ansprech: At the end of the Power Plant. Save before interacting; one-time Legendary encounter.
Stärkesteine in die Strömungslöcher schi: Push the Strength boulders into the holes to block the currents, then Surf to the lower pool.
Am Gipfel des Glutbergs. Stärkesteine ve: At Mt. Ember’s summit. Move the Strength boulders and save before interacting.
Ganz unten in der Azuria-Höhle. Eintritt: At the bottom of Cerulean Cave. Entry requires clearing the League, obtaining the National Pokédex and fully repairing Celio’s Network Machine with BOTH the Ruby and Sapphire.
Während der Rettung von Irrma im Beerenf: Encountered while rescuing Lostelle in Berry Forest. One-time encounter.
Historisches Verteilungs-Event: Geheimti: Historical distribution event: requires the MysticTicket. The area cannot normally be reached without a ticket obtained through the event. Save before battling.
Historisches Verteilungs-Event: Aurorati: Historical distribution event: requires the AuroraTicket. The area cannot normally be reached without a ticket obtained through the event. Save before battling.
Nach vollständiger Reparatur von Celios: After Celio’s Network Machine is fully repaired, one of the three Legendary beasts roams Kanto. Your starter determines which one. Track it in the Pokédex after the first sighting. In FRLG, Raikou and Entei can disappear permanently if they use Roar; save beforehand and prevent them from fleeing.

NPC-Tausch: das angegebene Tausch-Pokémo: In-game trade: give the requested Pokémon. The received Pokémon has the same level as the one you trade away.
Getragenes Item des vom NPC eingetauscht: Held by the Pokémon received in an in-game trade. Take the item from it after trading.
Dem Mädchen auf dem Dach einmal Tafelwas: Give the girl on the rooftop Fresh Water once. Each of the three drinks gives a different TM.
Dem Mädchen auf dem Dach einmal Sprudel: Give the girl on the rooftop Soda Pop once. Each of the three drinks gives a different TM.
Dem Mädchen auf dem Dach einmal Limonade: Give the girl on the rooftop Lemonade once. Each of the three drinks gives a different TM.
Als Preis für 4000 Münzen eintauschen. M: Exchange 4,000 Coins for this prize. Requires the Coin Case.
Als Preis für 3500 Münzen eintauschen. M: Exchange 3,500 Coins for this prize. Requires the Coin Case.
Als Preis für 4500 Münzen eintauschen. M: Exchange 4,500 Coins for this prize. Requires the Coin Case.
Als Preis für 800 Münzen eintauschen. Mü: Exchange 800 Coins for this prize. Requires the Coin Case.
Als Preis für 1000 Münzen eintauschen. M: Exchange 1,000 Coins for this prize. Requires the Coin Case.
Als Preis für 1600 Münzen eintauschen. M: Exchange 1,600 Coins for this prize. Requires the Coin Case.
Beim Beerenpulver-Mann gegen 50 Einheite: Exchange 50 units of Berry Powder with the powder man. Make powder by playing Berry Crush wirelessly with other players.
Beim Beerenpulver-Mann gegen 80 Einheite: Exchange 80 units of Berry Powder with the powder man. Make powder by playing Berry Crush wirelessly with other players.
Beim Beerenpulver-Mann gegen 300 Einheit: Exchange 300 units of Berry Powder with the powder man. Make powder by playing Berry Crush wirelessly with other players.
Beim Beerenpulver-Mann gegen 1000 Einhei: Exchange 1,000 units of Berry Powder with the powder man. Make powder by playing Berry Crush wirelessly with other players.
Beim Beerenpulver-Mann gegen 3000 Einhei: Exchange 3,000 units of Berry Powder with the powder man. Make powder by playing Berry Crush wirelessly with other players.
Selphy zunächst aus der Verlorenen Höhle: Rescue Selphy from Lost Cave first. Then show her the requested Pokémon within 250 steps. Repeatable random reward: Luxury Ball 70%; each of the six other rewards 5%.
Historische Wundernews-/Geheimgeschehen-: Historical Wonder News / Mystery Gift reward. Requires received or shared Wonder News. Depending on the message, receive a random Berry in a quantity of one or four. Not a normal walkthrough item.
Nach Abschluss des Einzel-Modus auf dem: After completing Single mode, collect the reward from the owner on the rooftop. Standard local Trainer Tower challenge; no e-Reader card required.
Nach Abschluss des Doppel-Modus auf dem: After completing Double mode, collect the reward from the owner on the rooftop. Standard local Trainer Tower challenge; no e-Reader card required.
Nach Abschluss des K.O.-Modus auf dem Da: After completing Knockout mode, collect the reward from the owner on the rooftop. Standard local Trainer Tower challenge; no e-Reader card required.
Nach Abschluss des Gemischt-Modus auf de: After completing Mixed mode, collect the reward from the owner on the rooftop. Standard local Trainer Tower challenge; no e-Reader card required.
Pokémon-Sprung mit drahtlosen Mitspieler: Pokémon Jump with wireless players: earn a random prize Berry from 5,000 points. Quantities: 5,000→1, 8,000→2, 12,000→3, 16,000→4, 20,000→5.
Beerenlese mit drahtlosen Mitspielern. M: Dodrio Berry Picking with wireless players. The possible prize Berry depends on your performance. A Dodrio is required.
Eichs Assistent: mindestens 10 verschied: Oak’s aide: catch at least 10 different species. Cut normally grants access to the eastern side; Diglett’s Cave is an alternative.
Eichs Assistent: mindestens 30 verschied: Oak’s aide: catch at least 30 different species.
Eichs Assistent: mindestens 20 verschied: Oak’s aide: catch at least 20 different species.
Eichs Assistent: mindestens 40 verschied: Oak’s aide: catch at least 40 different species.
Eichs Assistent: mindestens 50 verschied: Oak’s aide: catch at least 50 different species.
Durch den seitlichen Museumseingang mit: Use Cut to reach the scientist through the museum’s side entrance.
Goldzähne aus der Safari-Zone zum Wärter: Return the Gold Teeth from the Safari Zone to the Warden.
Superangel beim ersten Gespräch; ein Kar: Receive the Super Rod on your first conversation. Show a Magikarp for a Net Ball the first time, then for each new size record.
Ein Skaraborn vorzeigen: beim ersten Mal: Show a Heracross for a Nest Ball the first time, then for each new size record.
Nach der Liga in den nun fertig gegraben: After the League, return to the completed tunnel and speak to the prospector.
Limonade beim Gedenkstein für das versto: Leave Lemonade at the memorial to the deceased Onix, then receive TM42.
Einmalige Wahl zwischen Helixfossil und: One-time choice between the Helix Fossil and Dome Fossil. The other fossil remains behind in this save.
Mit Zerschneider den nördlichen Weg von: Use Cut to reach the house on Route 16’s northern path.
Nach dem Sieg über Giovanni mit dem Präs: Speak to the president after defeating Giovanni.
Innerhalb des Schrittlimits das Geheime: Reach the Safari Zone’s Secret House within the step limit.
Dem Kapitän nach dem Rivalenkampf helfen: Help the captain after the rival battle. Once you leave the ship with HM01, it departs for good; collect the remaining items first.
